claims.claim_text: At approximately 0520 hours, Officer C. Webb and I responded to an ADT commercial burglary alarm activation.
We arrived on scene within approximately two minutes of the dispatch call.
I walked the exterior perimeter of the building alone while Officer Webb remained at the front entrance to secure it.
Within approximately ten minutes, Sgt. Park, Officer Ruiz, and Officer Mateo arrived on scene.
He appeared calm and did not exhibit threatening behavior during this period.
Officer Mateo was designated to deploy a Taser as the less-lethal option.
Sgt. Park obtained a 40mm less-lethal launcher and positioned himself near the security gate.
I discharged my firearm approximately four times.
In total, officers fired approximately fifteen rounds.
We forced entry within approximately thirty seconds of the last shot.
The subject was barely conscious and unresponsive during transport.
The rifle recovered from the scene was later identified as belonging to the subject.
The subject emerged from a room on the southwest side of the building carrying a rifle in his right hand.
Officers immediately ordered the subject to drop the weapon.
It was a semi-automatic weapon chambered in .22 caliber with a full magazine.
